x_failures: Cites p.264 for Venus music being 'cheerful and light', but Ficino calls it 'voluptuous, with lewdness and softness'; captions Fludd p.731 as 'The divine hand tuning the Monochordum Mundi', but the page shows the Elemental Monochord of Earth, Water and Air.
y_failures: Says Kircher 'coined the term Phonocamptic Magic to describe the magic of the consonant and dissonant' (p.341), but the page defines it as sound reflection and mechanical music; says musical magnetism draws 'spirits', but pp.953/180 name only animals, woods and rocks; same 'hand of God' caption problem for Fludd p.731.
reason: Both answers misstate something on a cited page, but Y ties most of its claims to the right pages and adds relevant sources (Campanella on healing, Thorndike on Gnostic vowels). X gives fewer, thinner citations, gets Ficino's Venus wrong, and uses the wrong term 'Magia Parastatica'.
